parties.evidence: by and between Tickets.com, Inc., a Delaware corporation, located at 4061 Glencoe Ave., Marina del Rey, CA 90292 ("Tickets") and MP3.com, Inc., having an address at P.O. Box 910091, San Diego, CA 92191-0091 ("MP3.com").

agreement_date.evidence: This Sponsorship Agreement ("Agreement") is made an entered into on February 17, 1999 ("Effective Date")

effective_date.evidence: This Sponsorship Agreement ("Agreement") is made an entered into on February 17, 1999 ("Effective Date")

expiration_date.evidence: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall remain in full force and effect until one (1) year subsequent to the Effective Date

renewal_term.evidence: Tickets shall have the right to renew the Agreement for another year

governing_law.evidence: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California without reference to conflict of law principles thereof.

exclusivity.evidence: During the term of this Agreement, Tickets shall be MP3.com's exclusive partner/source for sports, entertainment, and travel tickets

uncapped_liability.evidence: Except for claims arising under section 6, in no event will either party be liable for any special, indirect, incidental or consequential damages.

termination_for_convenience.evidence: Tickets may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon thirty (30) days' notice to MP3. com at any time prior to the expiration of sixty (60) days subsequent to the Effective Date.

change_of_control.evidence: except that Tickets may assign this Agreement without MP3.com's consent if another entity acquires substantially all the assets of Tickets.
